title: Google sign-in (optional)
intro: Let staff and members sign in with a Google account as well. It signs in existing logins only: the Google address must match the login's verified email. You can skip this and set it up later in Settings → Google sign-in.
saved: Saved. Google accepted this client ID and secret. Google checks the redirect address only at sign-in: after setup, sign out and sign in with Google once.
unchecked: Saved, but Google couldn't be asked to check this client just now, so it may be wrong. After setup, sign out and sign in with Google once; if it fails, enter the client again in Settings → Google sign-in.
